The \(q+1\) explicit rational points give every line in the pencil. The executable checker exhausts exactly \((5^{10}-1)/4=2{,}441{,}406\) projective cubic forms and certifies maximum tangent coverage \(29<31\); lines and conics are ruled out geometrically.
